description: Live Polymarket prediction markets: outcome probabilities, 24h volume, liquidity, 24h price change and end date. Search by topic (query, e.g. 'bitcoin', 'election', 'fed rate') or omit query to get the markets with the highest 24h volume. Only open markets. Params: query (optional), limit (1 to 25, default 10). Price: $0.008 USDC per call, paid inside this MCP call via x402 (USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon or Arbitrum). x402 MCP clients such as @x402/mcp pay automatically. Free sample: call with the example input {"query":"bitcoin","limit":5}.

query.description: Topic to search, e.g. 'bitcoin' or 'election'. Omit for top markets by 24h volume.
